name: Safety.
line: Grants per isolate, a sanitised DOM, no inline scripts.
text: Isolates run on your origin, so they share its cookies and storage. Isoloop contains unreliable code (a widget that hangs, throws or leaks), not hostile code: for code you don’t trust at all, use a cross-origin iframe.

proof.test: I9: a hostile isolate gets no script, frame, handler or script URL onto the page
